purpose: Public-safe proof that Mac Henry evaluates income growth, wealth building, resource allocation and downside protection without exposing private financial strategy.
capital_rules: Positive expected revenue alone is insufficient; margin, cash timing, risk and opportunity cost must also be considered.
Recurring and repeatable income should be distinguished from one-time revenue.
Revenue growth that destroys margin or liquidity must be surfaced as a warning.
Pricing power, retention, cross-sell, reusable assets and automation leverage should be considered as compounding advantages.
Capital and owner attention are scarce resources and must be compared against alternative uses.
Material downside, irreversible commitments, leverage, custody, investment, trading, tax, legal or regulated-financial actions require appropriate human review and authorization.
No recommendation may imply guaranteed profit, guaranteed return or risk-free wealth creation.

Public Henry may prove that growth factors were evaluated but cannot access private balances, accounts, credentials, portfolio positions, private financial strategy or Mac Henry private scoring weights.
Growth analysis is advisory and never grants spending, transfer, trading, investment, contracting or execution authority.
